data.name: JobNoLongerListed
data.value: The printer no longer lists the job, so it has finished. The printer keeps no record of whether it printed successfully.
data.comment: State message for a job the printer or print server answers not-found for, as printers with little job history do soon after a job finishes.

data.name: JobPrinterGone
data.value: The printer or queue no longer exists, so how the job ended isn't known.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer or CUPS queue now answers not-found too, as when a queue is deleted with its jobs.

data.name: JobReasonUnsupportedOptions
data.value: The printer can't print the job with the options chosen.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer gives no job-state-message, from its job-state-reasons: unsupported-attributes-or-values or conflicting-attributes. CUPS cancels a job this way when its printer refuses an option, such as two-sided printing on a one-sided printer.

data.name: JobReasonUnsupportedFormat
data.value: The printer doesn't take the document's format.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer gives no job-state-message, from its job-state-reasons: unsupported-document-format

data.name: JobReasonDocumentUnreadable
data.value: The printer couldn't read the document.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer gives no job-state-message, from its job-state-reasons: document-format-error or document-unprintable-error

data.name: JobReasonCompression
data.value: The printer couldn't decompress the document.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer gives no job-state-message, from its job-state-reasons: unsupported-compression or compression-error

data.name: JobReasonDocumentProtected
data.value: The document is protected by a password or permissions, and the printer couldn't print it.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer gives no job-state-message, from its job-state-reasons: document-password-error, document-permission-error or document-security-error

data.name: JobReasonDocumentIncomplete
data.value: The document didn't reach the printer whole.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer gives no job-state-message, from its job-state-reasons: document-access-error or submission-interrupted

data.name: JobReasonAccounting
data.value: The printer's accounting didn't allow the job.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer gives no job-state-message, from its job-state-reasons: account-authorization-failed, account-closed, account-info-needed or account-limit-reached

data.name: JobReasonCanceledAfterTimeout
data.value: The job was cancelled after waiting too long.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer gives no job-state-message, from its job-state-reasons: job-canceled-after-timeout

data.name: JobReasonCanceledAtDevice
data.value: The job was cancelled at the printer.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer gives no job-state-message, from its job-state-reasons: job-canceled-at-device

data.name: JobReasonCanceledByOperator
data.value: The job was cancelled by the printer's operator.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer gives no job-state-message, from its job-state-reasons: job-canceled-by-operator

data.name: JobReasonCanceledByUser
data.value: The job was cancelled by the user who sent it.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer gives no job-state-message, from its job-state-reasons: job-canceled-by-user

data.name: JobReasonAbortedBySystem
data.value: The print system stopped the job.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer gives no job-state-message, from its job-state-reasons: aborted-by-system

data.name: JobReasonCompletedWithErrors
data.value: The job finished, with errors.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer gives no job-state-message, from its job-state-reasons: job-completed-with-errors

data.name: JobReasonCompletedWithWarnings
data.value: The job finished, with warnings.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer gives no job-state-message, from its job-state-reasons: job-completed-with-warnings

data.name: JobReasonHeldAtPrinter
data.value: The job is held until someone releases it at the printer.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer gives no job-state-message, from its job-state-reasons: job-held-for-authorization, job-held-for-button-press, job-held-for-release or job-password-wait

data.name: JobReasonHeldForReview
data.value: The job is held for review.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer gives no job-state-message, from its job-state-reasons: job-held-for-review

data.name: JobReasonHeldUntil
data.value: The job is held until the time it was given.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer gives no job-state-message, from its job-state-reasons: job-hold-until-specified

data.name: JobReasonPrinterStopped
data.value: The job is waiting: the printer is stopped.
data.comment: State message for a job whose printer gives no job-state-message, from its job-state-reasons: printer-stopped or printer-stopped-partly
